battle.name: 第三次中東戰爭
battle.brief: 第三次中東戰爭於1967年6月爆發，以色列與埃及、敘利亞等國在中東戰線交鋒；戰事主要發生在西奈半島、戈蘭高地及約旦邊境一帶。戰役中，以軍裝甲部隊使用美製M48巴頓坦克，負責正面突破、裝甲支援、占領要地，並與步兵協同作戰。

kit.name: 巴頓中型坦克
kit.history: M48是美國陸軍二戰後標準中型坦克體系的正式型號，擔任裝甲營主力，負責以主砲支援步兵、對抗裝甲目標並在機動作戰中推進占領。

cause: 1967年5月18日，埃及宣布聯合國緊急部隊必須撤出埃及邊境，並把更多步兵、裝甲與砲兵調入西奈。敘利亞也在北部集結部隊，使亞細亞走廊與戈蘭一線的兵力對比持續上升。到5月22日，埃及宣布自6月5日起封閉曼德海峽，使紅海航運及埃拉特港的南部出口受到直接威脅。以色列情報機關持續觀察埃及與敘利亞的集兵、彈藥及航空部署，政府在確認西奈攻擊橋頭已經形成後，批准以制空及打擊縱深目標為主的應急方案。6月5日天亮前，國防部長摩西·達揚、總參謀長伊扎克·拉賓與空軍司令莫德凱·霍德依此展開行動，使開戰前的軍事積累、作戰決定與第一批空襲在同一天連接起來。
causeEn: On 18 May 1967, Egypt declared that the United Nations Emergency Force had to leave Egyptian territory and moved additional infantry, armored, and artillery units into Sinai. Syria also concentrated forces in the north, further changing the military balance along the Asian corridor and the Golan front. On 22 May, Egypt announced that it would close the Straits of Tiran beginning on 5 June, directly threatening Red Sea shipping and the southern maritime outlet at Eilat. Israeli intelligence continued to monitor Egyptian and Syrian troop concentrations, ammunition movements, and air deployments. After confirming that attack positions had been prepared in Sinai, the Israeli government approved an emergency plan centered on gaining air superiority and striking targets in depth. Before dawn on 5 June, Defense Minister Moshe Dayan, Chief of Staff Yitzhak Rabin, and Air Force commander Mordechai Hod launched that course of action, linking the preceding military buildup, the decision for war, and the opening strikes within a single day.
countries: 6月5日開戰時，以色列面對的是三個前線國家與一支部隊較晚到達的支援力量。埃及在西奈部署最強大的陸軍，駐紮Bir el-Abd一帶的第二軍負責東側防務，轄有裝甲師與數個步兵師，並以多個師級單位交替掩護隘口、渡口和交通線。敘利亞在戈蘭、基恩湖及加利利一線部署步兵、裝甲與反戰車部隊，重點是阻止以色列裝甲部隊越過通向大馬士革的走廊。約旦把部隊部署在約旦河西岸及山脊地帶，形成從北部加利利到耶路撒冷附近的防線。埃及、約旦與敘利亞均隸屬以埃及為核心的阿拉伯協作架構，伊拉克則在戰事開始後向約旦派出裝甲與機步部隊。以色列Army分為北部、中部與南部三個戰區：中部面對約旦，南部指揮官同時處理加薩與西奈北部，第162步兵師、第252步兵師和第3裝甲師是西奈主要突擊力量，第55傘兵旅與第143裝甲旅投入加薩，另有數個裝甲旅調往戈蘭。這是一場縱深不同、裝備結構不同的聯合作戰，而不是所有戰線同時投入兵力。
countriesEn: When the war began on 5 June, Israel faced three frontline states and a supporting force that arrived later. Egypt maintained the strongest land force in Sinai. Its Second Army, headquartered around Bir el-Abd, controlled the eastern sector and included armored and infantry divisions positioned to support one another at passes, crossings, and transport routes. Syria deployed infantry, armor, and antitank formations in the Golan, around Lake Kinneret, and in Galilee to block an armored corridor toward Damascus. Jordan concentrated troops along the West Bank and ridge line, forming a front extending from Galilee to the approaches to Jerusalem. Egypt, Jordan, and Syria operated within an Arab coordination system centered on Cairo, while Iraq later sent armored and mechanized forces to Jordan. The Israeli Army was divided into northern, central, and southern commands. Central Command faced Jordan; Southern Command handled both Gaza and northern Sinai; the 162nd and 252nd Infantry Divisions and the 3rd Armored Division formed the principal Sinai striking forces; the 55th Paratroop Brigade and 143rd Armored Brigade were committed in Gaza; and several armored brigades were transferred to the Golan. The campaign therefore combined fronts with different depths and force structures rather than committing every formation simultaneously.
people: 以色列的最高決策由摩西·達揚主持，總參謀長伊扎克·拉賓負責全軍作戰，兩人必須在有限時間內把政治要求轉成可執行的軍事命令。空軍司令莫德凱·霍德掌握出動節拍、攻擊波次與臨時改變目標的權力；南部戰區總指揮約瑟夫·加維什所指的伊加埃爾·亞丁實際協調加薩及西奈南部。第162師由莫德凱·馬萊夫指揮，在Bir el-Abd建立主要中央橋頭；第252師由哈伊姆·巴爾-列夫指揮，沿中路向南推進；第3裝甲師由亞伯拉罕·亞丹指揮，在北部地區追求裝甲速度。戈蘭後續攻勢則由數個裝甲旅及步兵支隊分別實施。埃及方面，總統加麥爾·阿卜杜勒·納賽爾掌握最高權力，戰局惡化後由阿梅爾擔任統一戰線指揮，參謀系統則負責安排裝甲師與預備隊。約旦國王侯賽因能夠直接決定部隊是否繼續留在約旦河西岸；敘利亞總統哈菲茲·阿薩德則同時面對北部戰線失守與停火壓力。各戰區指揮官普遍依賴無線電、摩托車傳令與預設備用頻道，當指揮節點遭受空襲時，命令到達時間並不一致。空軍奪取主動後，日常戰術節奏很大程度交由前線指揮官決定，使其能根據隘口形狀、砲火密度及裝甲部隊位置調整推進方向。
peopleEn: Moshe Dayan presided over Israel's highest-level decisions, while Chief of Staff Yitzhak Rabin directed the army's operations. Together they had to turn political requirements into executable military orders within a narrow interval. Air Force commander Mordechai Hod controlled the timing of sorties, attack waves, and last-minute target changes. Southern Command under Yigael Yadin coordinated Gaza and southern Sinai. Mordechai Maklef commanded the 162nd Division and established the principal central bridgehead at Bir el-Abd. Haim Bar-Lev led the 252nd Division along the central axis toward the south, while Avraham Adan commanded the 3rd Armored Division in the northern sector, where speed and exploitation mattered most. The later Golan offensive was conducted by several armored brigades and supporting infantry formations. On the Egyptian side, President Gamal Abdel Nasser held supreme authority and appointed Field Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer to command the unified front as the situation deteriorated; the staff system arranged armored divisions and reserves. Jordan's King Hussein could decide directly whether Jordanian forces would remain deployed in the West Bank. Syria's President Hafez al-Assad faced both the collapse of the northern battle line and mounting pressure for a ceasefire. Commanders depended on radios, motorcycle messengers, and preset backup frequencies. When headquarters nodes were hit, orders did not always arrive at the same speed. Once the air force gained the initiative, tactical tempo largely rested with front commanders, who adjusted axes of advance according to crossing conditions, artillery density, and armored formations.
kits: 1967年的裝備差距主要表現在空軍與裝甲兵的射擊範圍、砲兵射程及後勤結構。以色列陸軍以M48A1裝甲車為突擊主力，車上90毫米砲與埃及T-34/85的85毫米砲、T-54或T-55的100毫米砲不能共用彈藥；少量Centurion使用105毫米砲，M24則使用75毫米砲，部分105毫米公制謝爾曼擔任支援任務。105毫米M68牽引砲、155毫米M51與1966年列裝的M65長射程榴彈砲提供戰術及縱深火力，還使用120毫米迫擊砲、M3半履帶車、謝爾曼工兵車與M32裝甲回收車。步兵主要使用7.62毫米FN FAL、MAG，以及9毫米Uzi。空軍可用機包括達索的Mirage IIIC、F-4A Phantom II、A-4 Skyhawk與F-8 Crusader，C-47負責 wounded personnel and supplies? Need no civilian but troops/supplies. We can say 人員與物資運輸。埃及與敘利亞陸軍裝備T-34/85、T-54、T-55、PT-76、M4謝爾曼及少量IS-3M，122毫米D-30、152毫米KS-3及203毫米B-4榴彈砲形成主要火力層。埃及與敘利亞空軍保有MiG-17、MiG-19及部分MiG-21PF，埃及另有Il-28轟炸機；約旦使用F-104 Starfighter與Hawker Hunter。埃及把S-75 Dvina導彈部署在開羅及尼羅河三角洲後方，但沒有在前線形成可逆轉地面劣勢的封鎖。各型裝甲車、飛機與火砲使用的燃料、備件及口徑並不相同，前進後必須分別維持彈藥車、加油車、抽水機及修理分隊，不能只根據總數判斷持續作戰能力。
kitsEn: The equipment gap in 1967 was expressed mainly through air range, artillery reach, and logistics. The Israeli Army relied on the M48A1 for its main armored thrust. Its 90mm gun could not share ammunition with the 85mm gun of the Egyptian T-34/85 or the 100mm gun of the T-54 and T-55. A small number of Centurions carried 105mm guns, while the M24 used 75mm ammunition; some 105mm metric Shermans provided support. The 105mm M68 towed howitzer, 155mm M51, and the long-range M65 howitzer, which entered service in 1966, supplied tactical and deep-fire support. The force also used 120mm mortars, M3 half-tracks, Sherman armored engineering vehicles, and M32 recovery vehicles. Infantry weapons included the 7.62mm FN FAL, MAG, and 9mm Uzi. Available aircraft included the Dassault Mirage IIIC, F-4A Phantom II, A-4 Skyhawk, and F-8 Crusader, while C-47 transports carried personnel and supplies. Egyptian and Syrian forces used T-34/85, T-54, T-55, PT-76, M4 Sherman, and limited IS-3M tanks. Their principal artillery layer included 122mm D-30, 152mm KS-3, and 203mm B-4 howitzers. Egyptian and Syrian air forces retained MiG-17, MiG-19, and some MiG-21PF aircraft, while Egypt also operated Il-28 bombers; Jordan used F-104 Starfighters and Hawker Hunters. Egypt deployed S-75 Dvina missiles around Cairo and the Nile Delta, but they did not form a barrier that could reverse the ground situation. Ammunition calibers, fuel, and spare parts differed across these systems, so every advance required separate ammunition vehicles, fuel trucks, water equipment, and repair detachments rather than a single consolidated logistics system.
tactics: 以色列的作戰起點是Operation Focus。第一波近兩百架作戰機在6月5日清晨進入空域，優先攻擊空場跑道、雷達站、彈藥庫、指揮節點與縱深交通設施，而不是把兵力平均分配給前線目標。Mirage IIIC迅速取得空戰優勢後，其他攻擊機反覆打擊仍在修復跑道的機場；工程人員雖能清除未爆彈、迅速鋪設便道，卻往往在跑道重新開放前再次遭受攻擊。地面作戰則遵循先空襲奪取局部優勢，再以步兵、工兵、砲兵和坦克協同突破的程序。埃及預先把主力放在渡口後方，倚賴壕溝、障礙物、反戰車砲和縱深預備隊；以色列師避免正面逐點攻擊全部工事，先由工兵打開出口，讓裝甲車進入狹窄通道，再繞過孤立據點，由步兵和砲兵逐段消除。約旦前線利用傘兵與裝甲車奪取山脊通道，使道路與城鎮節點迅速斷開；加薩戰區則把裝甲限制在可通行街道，再由傘兵清除堡壘。戈蘭的道路有限，坦克縱隊必須配置成前端坦克、中段步兵、後方工兵與防空的分段結構。推進速度受油料、水與彈藥限制，縱隊離開Beersheba、Gaza或Negev一帶的補給區後，需要前進加油點與彈藥轉運點保持供應，因此部分裝甲師在占領重要目標後必須停下整補。海軍行動主要限於近岸封鎖與少量岸轆射擊，沒有形成決定戰局的大型海戰。
tacticsEn: The operation began with Operation Focus. On the morning of 5 June, a first wave of nearly two hundred combat aircraft entered the airspace, prioritizing airfields and runways, radar stations, ammunition depots, command nodes, and transport links in depth rather than distributing effort evenly among frontline targets. Once the Mirage IIIC established air superiority, other attack aircraft repeatedly struck airfields whose crews were attempting to reopen their runways. Engineers could clear unexploded ordnance and lay emergency surfaces quickly, but they were often attacked again before operations resumed. Ground operations followed a sequence of gaining localized air superiority and then combining infantry, engineers, artillery, and tanks. Egypt placed most of its strength behind prepared crossings, relying on trenches, obstacles, antitank guns, and reserves in depth. Israeli formations avoided frontal attacks on every position. Engineers opened usable exits, armored vehicles passed through narrow gaps, and columns bypassed isolated strongpoints before infantry and artillery reduced them. On the Jordanian front, paratroopers and armored vehicles seized ridge corridors and rapidly disrupted roads and urban junctions. In Gaza, armor was confined to streets capable of carrying it, while paratroopers reduced fortified positions. Golan roads were limited, so tank columns were organized with tanks in front, infantry in the middle, and engineers and antiaircraft elements behind. Movement remained dependent on fuel, water, and ammunition. Once columns left supply zones around Beersheba, Gaza, or the Negev, forward fuel points and ammunition transfer points were required, forcing some armored divisions to halt after important objectives. Naval activity remained limited to coastal interdiction and occasional gunfire against shore positions and did not develop into a large naval battle.
data: 6月5日07時45分左右，以色列空軍發動第一波攻擊，埃及與敘利亞空場相連遭到打擊；到中午，埃及難以組織大規模反擊 sortie，約旦空軍與機場也在中午前後受襲。第162師在Bir el-Abd打開出口後迅速進入西奈中央部，攻入埃及第二軍指揮區，使開羅至前線的指揮節點與預備隊調度中斷。第252師在Nahal Oz方向建立橋頭，第3裝甲師則由汗尤尼斯與貝特哈納尼亞一線向北部縱深推進。第55傘兵旅和第143裝甲旅由加薩邊境向內壓縮，使埃及部署當地的步兵單位與沿海交通線受到壓力。中部戰區同日奪取Latrun與耶路撒冷東側通道，約旦部隊退往約旦河方向；敘利亞在戈蘭的第一線則仍阻止以色列部隊越過前沿。6月6日，埃及預備隊曾試圖在數個渡口方向實施反擊，但部隊在開闊地帶停留，受到以色列空軍、105毫米與155毫米砲兵連續打擊。第3裝甲師占領El-Qantara，第252師向Mitla Pass南側推進；加薩東側走廊中的埃及據點被逐個孤立，約旦河西岸的抵抗則退至Jenin、Nablus與Jericho一帶。6月7日，第252師以坦克、步兵與工兵協同控制Mitla Pass，第162師越過Bir Gifgafa並向Nakhes 6及Nakhes 8推進，約旦河西岸的主要防線則已失去連續性。6月8日，一支由南部戰區抽調的傘兵支隊越過Taba方向並占領Sharm el-Sheikh，装甲旅同時抵達Suez City北側；加薩剩餘堡壘受到包圍，北部戰線則開始在戈蘭撕開縱深。6月8日夜至9日凌晨，埃及軍在Chinese Farm一帶實施帶頭反擊，以色列前線部隊增援後才恢復控制。6月9日，敘利亞裝甲與步兵部隊在Sasa方向反擊，並在加利利的Cana一帶試圖威脅側翼，以色列裝甲、傘兵與砲兵合作後將其擋回。同日開始的戈蘭攻勢向Buteina與Quneitra方向推進，敘利亞部署的砲位與前進堡壘多被占領或失去射擊位置；以色列沒有向Mount Hermon最高部展開。6月10日至11日，雙方仍分別在戈蘭與其他前線交換砲火，至6月11日晚間，埃及、約旦與敘利亞依不同時間分別停止戰鬥。
dataEn: At about 07:45 on 5 June, the Israeli Air Force launched its first wave against Egyptian and Syrian airfields and their supporting network. By midday, Egypt could not organize a large retaliatory sortie, while Jordanian aircraft and airfields were struck around the same period. The 162nd Division opened an exit at Bir el-Abd and advanced rapidly into central Sinai, penetrating the Egyptian Second Army command area and disrupting command links and reserve movements between Cairo and the front. The 252nd Division established a bridgehead toward Nahal Oz, while the 3rd Armored Division advanced into northern depth around the Khan Yunis and Beit Hananya sector. The 55th Paratroop Brigade and 143rd Armored Brigade pressed inward from Gaza, compressing Egyptian infantry positions and coastal routes. Central Command seized Latrun and the approaches to East Jerusalem on the same day, and Jordanian forces withdrew toward the Jordan River. Syria's first line on the Golan initially prevented an Israeli penetration. On 6 June, Egyptian reserves attempted counterattacks toward several crossings, but their formations remained in exposed ground and were subjected to repeated attacks by Israeli aircraft and 105mm and 155mm artillery. The 3rd Armored Division occupied El-Qantara, while the 252nd advanced toward the southern approaches to Mitla Pass. Egyptian positions in Gaza's eastern corridor were isolated one by one, and resistance in the West Bank withdrew toward Jenin, Nablus, and Jericho. On 7 June, the 252nd Division brought tanks, infantry, and engineers together to secure Mitla Pass. The 162nd Division moved through Bir Gifgafa toward Nakhes 6 and Nakhes 8, while the main Jordanian line in the West Bank had already lost continuity. On 8 June, a paratroop detachment drawn from Southern Command crossed the Taba sector and occupied Sharm el-Sheikh, while an armored brigade reached the northern approaches to Suez City. Remaining Gaza fortifications were surrounded, and the northern front began opening depth in the Golan. During the night of 8 June and the early hours of 9 June, Egyptian troops counterattacked around Chinese Farm, and Israeli forward units required reinforcements before restoring control. On 9 June, Syrian armored and infantry forces counterattacked toward Sasa and attempted to threaten the flank with an operation from the Cana area in Galilee. Israeli armor, paratroopers, and artillery stopped these attacks. The Golan offensive beginning that day advanced toward Buteina and Quneitra, placing most forward Syrian guns and positions out of action or under Israeli occupation. Israeli forces did not continue to the highest part of Mount Hermon. Fighting continued in the Golan and on other fronts on 10 and 11 June. During the evening of 11 June, Egypt, Jordan, and Syria ceased fire at different designated times.
impact: 戰役造成的軍事影響可由指揮、裝備與地理三方面衡量。埃及第二軍指揮體系在6月5日被打斷，部署於加薩與西奈的許多渡口、砲陣和補給節點被占領或失去作用，但埃及仍有成建制部隊退往蘇伊士運河以西，並未在戰場上完全失去重建能力。約旦部隊退出西岸後，以色列控制了大片交通與防線；敘利亞在戈蘭的前沿砲兵和机械化單位失去原阵地，敘利亞政府則仍保有其他地區的部隊。以色列同樣損失飛機、坦克與作戰人員，並在數百公里的推進後面臨水源、燃料及修理距離限制，但大部分空場已可修復，空軍也維持了可供後續使用的戰鬥機隊。數百輛坦克、火砲、 vehicles and stocks of ammunition were captured? We should avoid English mismatch. Let's use Chinese only. 我們以中文繼續：以軍從西奈、加薩與約旦河西岸繳獲大量車輛、火砲、彈藥和備件，使之後的部署不必完全依賴戰前庫存，但外國車輛與不同口徑又增加了維修分類。傷亡方面，以色列、約旦與伊拉克保存較完整記錄，埃及與敘利亞仍有大量陣亡、失踪及被俘資料未能核對，各方把作戰、逃亡、失聯與後續死亡納入不同統計，因此無法負責任地列出一組完全精確的阿拉伯聯軍總數。這些不確定性不影響已確認的結論：六天內的戰鬥改變了砲兵陣地和裝甲部隊的配置，卻沒有使任何一個阿拉伯國家的全部軍隊同時消失。
impactEn: The military consequences can be measured through command, equipment, and geography. The Egyptian Second Army command system was disrupted on 5 June. Many crossings, gun positions, and supply nodes in Gaza and Sinai were occupied or rendered ineffective, but Egypt still retained organized formations west of the Suez Canal and was not completely deprived of the capacity to rebuild. After Jordanian forces withdrew from the West Bank, Israel controlled major transport routes and defensive lines. Syria lost its forward artillery and mechanized positions in the Golan, although the Syrian government retained forces in other regions. Israel also lost aircraft, tanks, and combat personnel. After advancing across several hundred kilometres, it faced constraints caused by water, fuel, and repair distances, although most airfields were capable of repair and its air force retained a usable combat inventory. Large quantities of vehicles, artillery pieces, ammunition, and spare parts captured in Sinai, Gaza, and the West Bank reduced reliance on prewar stocks, while foreign vehicle types and different calibres still complicated maintenance and classification. Israel, Jordan, and Iraq preserved comparatively complete records, but extensive Egyptian and Syrian records of dead, missing, and captured personnel remain incomplete. Different sources classified combat deaths, fugitives, missing personnel, and later deaths differently, so no single precise total for the Arab forces can be accepted without qualification. The uncertainty does not alter the confirmed result: six days of fighting changed the position of artillery formations and armored units, but did not cause the complete disappearance of any one Arab state's armed forces at the same moment.
result: 埃及首先接受停火，敘利亞與約旦隨後同意；停火在6月11日晚間依各戰區不同時刻生效，以色列也隨之停止進攻。停火後形成的主要線界顯示出雙方實際取得的控制區：以色列從加薩及西奈南部延伸到Suez運河南岸，埃及仍控制Suez City、運河與尼羅河三角洲；約旦恢復對約旦河西岸的軍事及行政控制，但該地同時受到以色列占領；以色列占領戈蘭的大部分南側陣地和Quneitra，敘利亞則仍控制Mount Hermon頂部及以北地區。這不是全面停戰條約所確定的永久邊界，雙方只是依軍事同意維持停火線。1967年6月22日，聯合國安全理事會通過第2334號決議，要求各方撤出戰爭中所佔領的領土並尋求政治解決；決議沒有立即改變當時的占領線。埃及、敘利亞與約旦在戰後整理部隊、恢復空軍並補充裝備，以色列則必須把遠距離戰果轉為長期駐防。最終的軍事結果是西奈、加薩、約旦河西岸及戈蘭南部的控制權轉移，蘇伊士運河和埃及本土未被占領；停火結束了戰役，後續占領與撤軍則另以軍方協議安排。
resultEn: Egypt accepted the ceasefire first, followed by Syria and Jordan; the ceasefires took effect at different designated times during the evening of 11 June, and Israel stopped its attacks accordingly. The principal lines established after the fighting showed the territory each side actually controlled. Israel extended its position from Gaza and southern Sinai to the south bank of the Suez Canal, while Egypt retained Suez City, the canal, and the Nile Delta. Jordan regained military and administrative control of the West Bank, although the territory remained under Israeli occupation. Israel occupied most of the southern Golan positions and Quneitra, while Syria retained the summit of Mount Hermon and the area north of it. These were not permanent borders fixed by a general peace treaty; both sides merely maintained armistice lines under military agreement. On 22 June 1967, the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 2334, calling for withdrawal from territories occupied during the war and for a political settlement. It did not immediately alter the lines of control then in place. Egypt, Syria, and Jordan reorganized their forces, rebuilt their air forces, and replenished equipment, while Israel had to convert operational gains at long range into a prolonged military presence. The final military result was a transfer of control over Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank, and the southern Golan, while the Suez Canal and Egyptian territory itself were not occupied. The ceasefires ended the campaign, while subsequent occupation and withdrawal were governed by separate military arrangements.
